Athlete.summary: Movement multiplier: ×1.01 while a non-QB carries a completed pass; ×1.02 on RB/FB runs; ×1.05 on QB runs/scrambles and pass blitzes.
Athlete.limits: Context-specific movement, not a universal speed increase. Independent movement traits multiply. Do not purchase a duplicate of an automatic trait.
Athlete.unmodeled: Actual workload, role frequency and RunningQB export state are not measured.

BionicLeg.summary: Portal upgrade raises the kick-power cap another five points, to 100.
BionicLeg.limits: Requires SteelToeBoots and listed attribute prerequisites. Cap unlock only: additional ratings still cost TPE. No identically named stock game trait.
BionicLeg.modeled: Kick-power cap unlock and prerequisite costs.

BlockingFB.summary: Adds 10 to the blocking engagement threshold when the player is a fullback; reduces fullback target-selection weight by 10, with a floor of one.
BlockingFB.limits: Position-gated. A blocking benefit also changes receiving opportunities; threshold points are not percentage points of team win probability.

BlockingTE.summary: Adds 10 to the blocking engagement threshold when the player is a tight end; reduces tight-end target-selection weight by 10, with a floor of one.
BlockingTE.limits: Position-gated. Stacks with independent blocking traits. Reduced receiving opportunities are not necessarily beneficial.

BoxSafety.summary: Adds one or two to run-recognition thresholds in specified branches; multiplies strong-safety tackle score by 1.03 on runs when the near-line condition passes.
BoxSafety.limits: Recognition bonuses participate in precedence chains. Tackle benefit requires SS position and tackler Y minus ball Y below 25 field units.
BoxSafety.modeled: Cover-action run-recognition threshold in a declared scenario.
BoxSafety.unmodeled: Near-line SS tackle multiplier and other recognition branches.

BullRusher.summary: Subtracts 10 from the opposing blocker's engagement threshold and multiplies movement by 1.05 while blitzing a pass.
BullRusher.limits: Blocking and blitz contexts only. Stacks independently with SpeedRusher. Do not purchase a duplicate automatic trait.
BullRusher.modeled: Opposing blocking threshold and conditional blitz movement.
BullRusher.unmodeled: Actual pass-rush opportunity and opponent context.

CenterFielder.summary: Stock Centerfielder reduces the interception comparison modifier by one; also changes passes-defensed credit after a failed catch.
CenterFielder.limits: Portal spelling differs from stock enum Centerfielder. Perceptive takes precedence; the credit bonus does not prevent a completion. Interception effects depend on integer-rounded joint scores.
CenterFielder.modeled: Interception modifier with Perceptive precedence in a separable coverage approximation.
CenterFielder.unmodeled: Joint integer rounding and post-failure statistical credit.

Competitor.summary: Prevents the competitiveness-dependent 10% tackle-score reduction after at least five recorded tackles.
Competitor.limits: The separate reduction after eight tackles remains. Benefit depends on competitiveness and workload; passes-defensed credit is attribution only. Integer truncation applies.
Competitor.unmodeled: Recorded tackle workload, integer rounding and statistical credit.

DeepThreat.summary: Adds 10 to deep-target selection weight and multiplies movement by 1.01 while carrying a completed pass.
DeepThreat.limits: Does not supply a universal route-speed or catch-probability bonus. Additional deep targets are strategy-dependent. Do not purchase a duplicate automatic trait.
DeepThreat.unmodeled: Deep-target selection weighting and third-down selection.

Dualthreat.summary: Multiplies QB run/scramble movement by 1.05, adds 30 to scramble tendency, and supplies a 1.05 resistance multiplier in the QB-run branch.
Dualthreat.limits: RunningQB is a separate flag: its overlapping movement/resistance multiplier does not stack with this trait, while scramble tendency can stack. Game plans can override tendency.
Dualthreat.unmodeled: Resistance, scramble tendency and separate RunningQB flag.

GameManager.summary: Adds four to the QB interception random-range parameter and adds min(5, intelligence/15) to a throwaway decision threshold.
GameManager.limits: FilmGeek takes precedence in the interception chain and supplies two instead. This is not a four-percentage-point reduction in interceptions.
GameManager.modeled: Interception range bonus with FilmGeek precedence, compared with attribute range tiers.
GameManager.unmodeled: Throwaway behavior and full nonlinear interception probability.

Gunslinger.summary: Adds five to a deep-throw preference accumulator when deep consideration is allowed.
Gunslinger.limits: Fourth down and field position can disable this branch. A preference change has no established positive win value without the surrounding strategy and roster.
Gunslinger.unmodeled: Deep-throw preference has no assumed universal benefit.

LaserSights.summary: Portal upgrade raises the kick-accuracy cap another five points, to 100.
LaserSights.limits: Requires StraightShooter and listed attribute prerequisites. Cap unlock only: additional ratings still cost TPE. No identically named stock game trait.
LaserSights.modeled: Kick-accuracy cap unlock and prerequisite costs.

Perceptive.summary: Adds four or five to specified run-recognition thresholds and reduces the interception comparison modifier by three.
Perceptive.limits: Branch-dependent recognition; takes precedence over Centerfielder and Legend in interception calculation. Modifier effects depend on joint integer-rounded scores.
Perceptive.modeled: Cover-action recognition scenario and precedence-aware interception modifier.
Perceptive.unmodeled: Other recognition branches and joint integer rounding.

PressCorner.summary: Adds one to specified run-recognition thresholds; also changes passes-defensed credit after a failed catch.
PressCorner.limits: Earlier Perceptive or BoxSafety branches take precedence. Credit attribution is not evidence of preventing the completion.
PressCorner.unmodeled: Other recognition branches and statistical-credit changes.

RawTalent.limits: Role and play context apply; no universal attribute increase. Independent movement multipliers stack.

ReceivingTE.summary: Adds two to tight-end target-selection weight and multiplies pass-ballcarrier movement by 1.05.
ReceivingTE.limits: Its drop-threshold reduction labels an already failed pass and does not create a catch. Receiving-trait attribution bonuses use an else-if chain.

RoleModel.summary: Reduces the penalty threshold by 10 for the randomly selected player, the same local threshold change as 10 intelligence points.
RoleModel.limits: BadInfluence, Diva and MediaDarling take precedence. This is not an overall intelligence increase; selection, random ranges and penalty eligibility still apply.
RoleModel.modeled: Penalty-resistance intelligence subtotal with trait precedence.
RoleModel.unmodeled: Actual player selection, penalty denominator and matchup context.

ScatBack.summary: Multiplies pass-ballcarrier movement by 1.01 and RB/FB rushing movement by 1.02; increases automatic third-down-back selection preference.
ScatBack.limits: Movement benefits require their respective contexts. Selection preference is not a per-play performance multiplier.

ShutDownCorner.summary: Adds 15 to a passes-defensed credit accumulator after a failed catch.
ShutDownCorner.limits: This branch assigns statistical credit; it does not prevent the completion. No direct completion-prevention benefit was verified, so it has no modeled prevention value.
ShutDownCorner.unmodeled: Post-failure passes-defensed credit; no verified prevention effect.

SlotCorner.summary: Multiplies pass-blitz movement by 1.05; changes a run-ballcarrier path threshold from 25 to 15.
SlotCorner.limits: The run-path source genuinely names SlotCorner, not SlotReceiver. That ballcarrier branch is not an ordinary corner coverage benefit.

SlotReceiver.summary: Multiplies pass-ballcarrier movement by 1.01 and changes a pass-ballcarrier path threshold from 25 to 15.
SlotReceiver.limits: These effects occur with the ball, not as a universal route-running bonus. Path outcomes also depend on intelligence, endurance, agility and speed.

SpeedRusher.summary: Subtracts 10 from the opposing blocker's engagement threshold and multiplies pass-blitz movement by 1.05.
SpeedRusher.limits: Blocking and blitz contexts only. Stacks independently with BullRusher. Do not purchase a duplicate automatic trait.
SpeedRusher.modeled: Opposing blocking threshold and conditional blitz movement.
SpeedRusher.unmodeled: Actual pass-rush opportunity and opponent context.

SteelToeBoots.summary: Portal upgrade raises the kick-power cap five points, to 95.
SteelToeBoots.limits: Listed prerequisites must be met. Cap unlock only: additional ratings still cost TPE. Required before BionicLeg; no identically named stock game trait.
SteelToeBoots.modeled: Kick-power cap unlock and prerequisite costs.

StraightShooter.summary: Portal upgrade raises the kick-accuracy cap five points, to 95.
StraightShooter.limits: Listed prerequisites must be met. Cap unlock only: additional ratings still cost TPE. Required before LaserSights; no identically named stock game trait.
StraightShooter.modeled: Kick-accuracy cap unlock and prerequisite costs.

TenaciousBlocker.summary: Adds 10 to the blocking engagement threshold.
TenaciousBlocker.limits: Stacks with AthBlocker and applicable position-specific blocking traits. The comparison still depends on the opponent, random roll and other modifiers; not a ten-percent win gain.
TenaciousBlocker.unmodeled: Actual opponent, contact opportunity and random-roll clamping.
